in_sanskrit.name: Mularam
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of mountains
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mularam एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mula means root or origin and Rama means pleasing or delighting. Mularam is the name of a god who is believed to reside in the mountains and is the protector of all mountain dwellers. He is also revered by the tribes living in mountainous regions.
